title: Decide whether one indicator can drive an action
description: Choose an observable, choose the intended defensive use, and add analysis delay. The model separates evidence quality from action blast radius so a useful hunting lead does not silently become an unsafe block rule.

indicators.label: Fresh phishing domain
indicators.detail: A newly registered lookalike domain tied to a reviewed credential-phishing campaign.

indicators.label: Malware file hash
indicators.detail: A sample hash with strong sandbox context but only two sightings in the modeled environment.

indicators.label: Shared hosting IP
indicators.detail: An address seen in malicious traffic that also hosts unrelated tenants and legitimate services.

indicators.label: Known public resolver
indicators.detail: A high-volume infrastructure address that a warning list identifies as likely benign context.

actions.label: Use as a hunting lead
actions.detail: Search historical telemetry and collect more context without changing user or network access.

actions.label: Create a reviewable alert
actions.detail: Notify an analyst while keeping a human decision between the indicator and containment.

actions.label: Automate prevention
actions.detail: Push a deny decision to a control that can block traffic, files, or identities.
